summary: Greek polydefinites ('i mavres i gates') as prominence markers, after Chatzikyriakidis & Spathas (2023): polydefinites are given truth conditions identical to monadic definites plus a context-update that fronts the referent in a prominence list; the rival Lekakou & Szendroi (2012) intersective/R-role account is staged against ten worked examples from the paper (alleged perpetrator, former PM, fast speaker, venomous cobras, White Tower chant, topic shift, other author, ...), each rendered as a scenario Axiom block with an 'LS fails / ours works' theorem pair. The prominence mechanism itself is hollow: make_first is an uninterpreted Parameter with no specification, so every prominence theorem is a reflexivity-unfolding, and the von Heusinger & Schumacher (2019) ProminenceMarking record (Defs 1-3) is declared but never instantiated or used. Truth-conditional identity is encoded by defining both readings as the same predicate, making the equivalence theorems trivial. 47 theorem statements, 46 Qed (many trivial or duplicated), 1 Abort, 25 propositional Axioms.

sources.citation: Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Spathas, G. (2023). A unified analysis of the semantics and pragmatics of Greek polydefinites. LENLS 20, Osaka (journal version 'Polydefinites as Markers of Prominence' under review). Header spells 'Chatzykiriakidis & Spathas (2023)'.
von Heusinger, K. & Schumacher, P. B. (2019). Prominence in discourse (Defs 1-3 of prominence). Journal of Pragmatics 154.
Lekakou, M. & Szendroi, K. (2012). Polydefinites in Greek: Ellipsis, close apposition and expletive determiners. Journal of Linguistics 48(1):107-149 (the rival account the file argues against).

evidence: The file tracks the source's actual argument structure: ten worked examples matching the paper's numbered examples (16, 19-20, 26, 27, 42, 53, 60, 62), the questionnaire scores (6.7/7.3, 8.5, 8.1/8.6, 7.4/7.3) quoted in comments, and the L&S contrast — so its theorems concern the source's objects.

But the two headline mechanisms are hollow: truth-conditional identity is stipulated (polydefinite := monadic_definite verbatim, equivalences by reflexivity), and prominence update rests on the uninterpreted Parameter make_first with zero axioms — no theorem can say the referent actually becomes most prominent; the von Heusinger & Schumacher ProminenceMarking record (Defs 1-3) is declared and never used.

no_grammatical_restrictivity refutes a mis-transcribed restrictivity requirement (~P y for ~P x — a self-contradictory strawman), and ban_on_vacuous_identification as axiomatized entails the emptiness of any A included in N, contradicting domain inhabitation (unused by Qed proofs, so latent).

46 Qed theorems, 0 Admitted, but most substantive ones depend on the 25 scenario/theory Axioms (loosely tied to the paper's example contexts, not documented per rubric 3b) and the rest are reflexivity-unfoldings; per rubric 3 the trivial ones would be excluded by a verifier.
simplifications: no compositional syntax-semantics for determiner spreading — the polydefinite is a predicate, not a derived DP meaning
felicity conditions and restrictive_alternatives are True/nil placeholders
questionnaire evidence lives in comments only
example contexts stipulated as Axiom blocks rather than constructed models
omissions: the actual content of prominence (von Heusinger & Schumacher Defs 1-3: record declared, never instantiated)
any specification of make_first/first (the update mechanism)
the paper's questionnaire methodology and felicity-scale semantics
additions: verbatim duplicate theorems (prominence_among_alternatives/...1) and duplicated comment blocks

determination_rationale: By the rubric table this is the matching row — only a partial formalization exists, with core constructs changed (prominence rendered as an unaxiomatized list operation, 'alleged' strengthened to anti-subsective, L&S's Ban mis-rendered as denotation emptiness). The caveat is that none of these changes is shown to be FORCED by mechanization: they read as pilot-file shortcuts, and the theory's actual commitments (stipulated truth-conditional identity + a use-conditional prominence update over a salience ranking) look mechanizable with at most slight modification — e.g. make_first as remove-then-cons with first (make_first x l) = Some x proved, and felicity as a genuine condition on contexts. The determination is therefore provisional evidence from a weak formalization and should be revisited after an atlas-discipline rebuild; the one genuine substrate pressure it does reveal is that the prominence/felicity dimension is use-conditional meaning with no home in an extensional Prop fragment.

artifact_classes.description: missing native structure for use-conditional/expressive meaning and discourse salience: the extensional Montague fragment has no dimension for felicity or prominence, so prominence degrades to an uninterpreted list Parameter (make_first, no spec), felicity conditions to True placeholders, and von Heusinger & Schumacher's prominence definition to an uninstantiated record shell; all prominence theorems are consequently definitional unfoldings
